claim: Database Insights Standard mode includes up to 7 days of detailed database and per-query metrics retention at no additional cost; for retention beyond 7 days you can configure 1 to 24 months, at the same price as Performance Insights; Advanced mode supports 1–24 months of retention at no additional cost.

evidence.quote: If you enable Database Insights Standard mode, Database Insights includes up to 7 days of detailed database and per-query metrics retention at no additional cost.
For retention beyond 7 days, you can configure retention from 1 to 24 months.
Database Insights Advanced mode supports retention of detailed database and per-query metrics for 1–24 months, at no additional cost.
Standard mode supports flexible retention of 1–24 months at the same price as Performance Insights.
